class.name: CbMotionPart
class.brief_description: What the motion nodes share: each bakes to lines of a motions file, and says in the scene tree when it cannot.
class.description: The base of [CbMotionSet], [CbMotion], [CbProbe] and the effects ([CbMotionEffect]: [CbImpulse], [CbForce], [CbLink]). Not a node to add: add those. A set has motions; a motion has a probe and effects. Every one of them is data only: saving the scene bakes the tree to one file, and a node that cannot be baked shows a warning in the scene tree and refuses the bake, naming itself and why.
